description: Facing SSW; one of only two JMSDF S-62s left in Japan; the data plate is readable through the clouded right lower window and gives the type simply as S-62 with no J suffix; at 34.1305N 134.5990E
One of only two complete S2F-1s left in Japan; badly faded to near-white by 2022; at 34.1305N 134.5988E
Display aircraft just inside the main gate; a second TC-90 is used for fire training at the ShinMaywa works alongside the base; no serial recorded in the source
Nose section only inside the base PR room as a walk-in cockpit exhibit; the radio call 6702 survives on the panel
